description: This file contains unit tests for the LoanChargeEffectiveDueDateComparator class, which sorts LoanCharge objects based on their effective due dates in the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanChargeEffectiveDueDateComparatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the sorting logic of LoanChargeEffectiveDueDateComparator based on effective due dates.

methods.name: testLoanChargeEffectiveDueDateComparator
methods.description: Tests the comparison and sorting of LoanCharge objects by their effective due dates in ascending order.

methods.name: testBothNull
methods.description: Tests that two LoanCharge objects with null due dates are considered equal and their order remains unchanged.

methods.name: testOneOfThemIsNull
methods.description: Tests sorting behavior when one LoanCharge has null due date and the other has a non-null due date, including cases with installment charges.
